title: CareerShakers - Videos
description:
If you're here, that means you want you shake up your career by getting a new job, getting promoted, or changing careers! 

As a Fortune 5 recruiter and former Management Consultant, I've learned what hiring teams want and how to successfully switch careers. So on this channel, you'll get practical career advice that your recruiter or friends won't tell you. 

I truly believe it is never too late to level up your career or pursue what makes you happy. Make sure to subscribe and leave a comment with what other content you'd find helpful.
